title: Choose the visual world for muhamed.at
question: The roll assigned The Drawing Sheet. Keep it, take Impeccable's pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: ISO and ÖNORM engineering drawings: title blocks, dimension lines and redline review
options.thesis: Your practice as a drawing under review: agents draft, a human signs the title block.
options.viewport: A full sheet with border and title block; the headline is the drawing's main note, the working loop is drawn as a dimensioned part, and the proof numbers are its dimensions.
options.risk: Reads as CAD cosplay if the lettering or line weights are timid, and heavy line art has to stay scannable for a busy hiring manager.

raised.raise: Linked constraints: change one dimension and the dependent ones update, so the guardrail idea is felt rather than stated.
Motion is the line drawn in sequence: dimension lines and leaders draw themselves once, in construction order.
Newest is darkest: the latest posts and notes carry the heaviest line weight, older ones fade to construction grey.
Stations in order: Diagnose, Prove and Hand over are revision stages with approval stamps that cannot be skipped.
One continuous run: a single guardrail line threads the page from the first viewport to the contact block.

options.label: The Vienna Method
options.lineage: Isotype, Otto Neurath and Gerd Arntz, Vienna from 1925
options.thesis: Your evidence counted in pictograms: facts seen at a glance, in Vienna's own invention.
options.viewport: The headline beside one Isotype chart: 30 engineers as 30 figures, 7 time zones, 9 releases, each row a fact you can count.
options.risk: The most familiar strong option, and pictograms need careful authoring to stay clear of infographic kitsch.

options.label: Claim and Proof
options.thesis: Every claim followed at once by the artefact that proves it.
options.viewport: Two columns: the claim on the left, a framed real artefact on the right, such as an enola verdict, a pi-brain gate or a CI check.
options.case: Fuses cleanly, since your tools produce real output to frame; holds on clarity, loses on identification to a world engineers recognise.
options.risk: Close to the category standard; distinct only if every framed artefact is genuinely yours.

options.label: Deployable Fold Sheet
options.thesis: One pull unfolds a whole field of linked creases.
options.viewport: A folded packet that opens into the full practice.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the metaphor is about deployment, not about the people who hire you.
options.kept: Linked constraints: one change propagates through the whole structure.

options.label: Blackbook Wildstyle
options.thesis: The name as one interlocked mark.
options.viewport: The name knitted into one mass with arrows as navigation.
options.case: Fuses poorly: unreadable by design, the opposite of what a CTO needs.
options.kept: Motion as a stroke drawn in sequence.

options.label: Marbled Ink Basin
options.thesis: A live surface where the newest drop is darkest.
options.viewport: A fluid surface the pointer stirs.
options.case: Fuses poorly: beautiful, but it says nothing about engineering control.
options.kept: Newest is darkest: recency carried by the material itself.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: Work moves through fixed stations in order.
options.viewport: Stations from expose to dry, the work emerging slowly.
options.case: Fuses poorly: moody and slow where visitors want a fast read.
options.risk: Dark and slow for a quick check.
options.kept: Stations in a fixed order, with points you cannot go back past.

options.label: Hand-bent Neon
options.thesis: One continuous glass line that lights as a circuit.
options.viewport: A dark room where the name ignites as one line.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nightlife glow is the dark-plus-neon default to avoid.
options.kept: One continuous run that connects everything.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A senior consultant's personal site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and headshot, services, selected work, contact: what visitors expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other consultant by design.
